# Varish Partners

> Varish Partners is a tax, finance and strategic advisory firm in Mangaluru, India, serving founders, promoters, startups and established businesses. The firm combines direct and indirect tax, CFO-level financial advice, strategy, transactions and cross-border work, led by its partners rather than delegated.

Key facts:
- Location: Maurishka Park, MG Road, Near Canara Bank, Kodialbail, Mangaluru 575003, Karnataka, India
- Phone: +91 87480 20569, +91 99721 56327
- Email: info@varishpartners.com
- Partners: Varun Shenoy (Managing Partner), Vishwanath Prabhu (Partner)
- Experience: over 20 years of combined experience across tax, compliance and corporate advisory
- Full text of the pages below, in one file: https://www.varishpartners.com/llms-full.txt

## Services
- [Tax Advisory & Compliance](https://www.varishpartners.com/tax-consultancy-compliances/): Helping businesses manage tax efficiently, compliantly and strategically.
- [CFO & Financial Advisory](https://www.varishpartners.com/fractional-cfo-services/): Financial clarity and decision support for growing businesses.
- [Strategy & Growth Advisory](https://www.varishpartners.com/strategic-consulting-impact/): Turning business ambitions into executable growth strategies.
- [Transaction & Corporate Advisory](https://www.varishpartners.com/business-advisory-services/): Advising businesses through critical transactions and strategic events.
- [Cross-Border & International Advisory](https://www.varishpartners.com/cross-border-international-advisory/): Helping businesses navigate international expansion, investments and transactions.
- [Startup & Venture Advisory](https://www.varishpartners.com/start-up-advisory-and-consultancy-services/): From incorporation to institutional capital and scale.
- [Risk & Due Diligence](https://www.varishpartners.com/risk-due-diligence/): Independent insight into financial, tax and business risks.
- [Business Setup, Compliance & Governance](https://www.varishpartners.com/business-registration-services/): Building the financial and regulatory foundation for businesses.

## Our Thinking (articles)
- [Our Thinking](https://www.varishpartners.com/insights/): Index of all articles.
- [ODI Simplified: What Indian Founders Need to Know Before Investing Abroad](https://www.varishpartners.com/odi-simplified-guide-for-indian-founders/): The moment an Indian company invests abroad, a compliance clock starts immediately, and most founders only discover it when a bank or an investor flags a missing filing.
- [Spotlight: Unlocking Control of a Scarce Industrial Asset Ahead of Schedule](https://www.varishpartners.com/regulatory-deadlock-industrial-land-acquisition/): How a bespoke ownership and control framework gave a client operational control of a scarce industrial site years ahead of formal title transfer, while staying fully compliant.
- [India’s Startup Redefinition 2026: Are You Still a “Startup” Under the New Norms?](https://www.varishpartners.com/indias-startup-redefinition-2026/): The Government of India just fundamentally changed the game for entrepreneurs, significantly expanding who qualifies for “Startup” status.
- [MSME Reforms 2026: Why Faster Payments Matter](https://www.varishpartners.com/msme-reforms-2026-why-faster-payments-matter/): You can have strong orders and healthy margins, but if customers don’t pay on time, growth can quickly become a working capital crisis.
- [Mastering Cash Flow: Essential Strategies to Keep Your Business Thriving](https://www.varishpartners.com/mastering-cash-flow-essential-strategies-to-keep-your-business-thriving/): Managing cash flow is one of the most critical aspects of running a successful business.
- [Optimizing Pricing Strategy for a Wholesaler](https://www.varishpartners.com/optimizing-pricing-strategy-for-a-wholesaler/): A wholesaler in the consumer goods sector approached Varish Partners with a significant challenge: one dominant retailer accounted for approximately 60% of their sales.
